name: Glyphs
tagline: One tiny formula, a field of breathing dots
about: A field of dots and one line of maths. Every frame, every dot asks the formula how big to be: positive glows ember, negative goes violet. I love how little it takes. sin(t - r) is a pond, a comparison is a stencil, x & y is a Sierpinski triangle hiding in plain sight. Press Compose and I will write you a piece; type over it and see what breaks, beautifully.
